template.generator: runtime-supported SMPL-X neutral big-pose fallback reproduced in a dedicated preprocessing tool
template.limitation: This is the runtime-supported 10,475/20,908 SMPL-X fallback, not the unrecoverable subject02 96,380/192,744 loose-clothing topology.

command_template: Create an isolated ${RUN_ID}/data staging root outside both raw datasets.
Copy only subject00/smpl_params.npz into ${RUN_ID}/data and verify its hash.
Copy the sealed PointInterpolant binary to ${RUN_ID}/PointInterpolant and verify ff516f19...ca2b.
lbs_grid.determinism_limitation: The frozen inputs and command are reconstructable; byte determinism of the 12-thread external solver remains PENDING_MANUAL_CONFIRMATION and requires two isolated runs.

initial_gaussians.requirement: sample the sealed subject00 template with an explicit seed; do not let Scene create it implicitly

validation_gates: exact source HEAD and raw runtime closure
subject00 raw fingerprint unchanged before staging
SMPL-X model and PointInterpolant hashes exact
two isolated template generations have identical array hashes
two isolated LBS generations have identical NPZ payload array hashes
grid shape [128,128,128,55], float32, finite, nonnegative, per-voxel joint sum within tolerance
no symlinks or unexpected files in the publish set
atomic publish only after all gates pass
post-publish loader and model-forward smoke remains a later authorized task

estimated_disk.reason: two independent solver staging roots, temporary text gradients/grids, and 10 GiB safety reserve
